menu.surrenderBody: All your territory will return to the wild.
menu.loadSubtitle: Ten save slots, plus an automatic save every two minutes.

help.intro: Isoline is played on a living atlas: spread your ink, build an economy, forge alliances and hold the world.
help.click: Left click a neighbouring land: land attack. On a coast across the water: naval landing.
help.radial: Right click: context menu (build, weapons, ships, diplomacy). Alt + click: emojis.
help.drag: Drag (left or middle button): move the map. Shift + drag: select warships.
help.wheel: Wheel / pinch: zoom. Shift + wheel: attack ratio.

hud.loyaltyHint: Loyalty layer: freshly conquered lands are unstable.
hud.fogLocked: The fog of war can only be lifted when spectating or in a replay.
hud.attackRatioTip: Share of your troops sent with each attack or expansion order.
hud.capTip: Current population compared with the ceiling set by your land and cities.
hud.growthTip: Population growth per second. It peaks around 42% of the ceiling.
hud.immuneTip: Nobody can attack you during this time.
hud.populationTip: Total population = troops + workers. Cities and land raise the ceiling.
hud.spawnHelp: Click on unclaimed land. The match starts as soon as your capital is placed.
hud.traitorTip: You betrayed an ally: your defence is reduced and other nations remember it.
hud.troopShareTip: How growth is split between troops (to fight) and workers (for gold).
hud.troopsTip: Troops available to attack and defend.
hud.victoryThresholdTip: The first country (or team) to control {pct}% of the useful land wins.

radial.embargoDesc: Cuts sea and rail trade with this country.
radial.attackDesc: Sends the shown share of your troops (adjust with T / Y or Shift + wheel).
radial.boatDesc: Ships troops from your nearest coast and lands them here.

confirm.betrayBody: Attacking an ally breaks the alliance: defence ×0.5 and speed ×0.8 for 30 s, traitor mark and embargo for 5 minutes.

diplo.giveTip: Sends 10% of your gold to this ally.
diplo.intro: An alliance lasts 5 minutes and forbids attacks between allies. Renewing requires both parties' consent. Attacking an ally is a betrayal: halved defence for 30 s and an automatic embargo.

council.ceasefire: The Council imposes a 60-second general ceasefire.
council.noMajority: The Council adjourns without a majority.
council.sanctions.name: Sanction the leader
council.sanctions.desc: The largest player's income is halved for 3 minutes.
council.nukeBan.name: Nuclear ban
council.ceasefire.name: Ceasefire
council.ceasefire.desc: No new attacks between players for 60 seconds.

tech.intro: Research progresses thanks to your cities. Pick a branch: its next level will be studied automatically.

weather.name: Weather & day/night
weather.desc: 8-minute cycle, storms slowing ships, fog banks.

fog.name: Fog of war
fog.desc: You only see what your lands, ships, radars and planes reveal.

tech.name: Technology tree
tech.desc: 5 branches × 4 levels, research produced by cities.

resources.name: Strategic resources
resources.desc: Oil, uranium, fertile land and rare metals.

loyalty.name: Loyalty & secession
loyalty.desc: Fresh conquests may secede if poorly garrisoned.

events.name: World events
events.desc: Crises, pandemics, trade booms, solar storms, peace summits.

generals.name: Generals
generals.desc: One active ability per player (5-minute cooldown).

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.desc: Defence posts twice as effective for 30 s.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.desc: Destroys the enemy train or merchant ship nearest the target point.

propaganda.name: Propaganda
propaganda.desc: +50% loyalty for 60 s, no secession possible.

city.name: City
city.desc: +250,000 max population per level, produces research. Railway station.

port.name: Port
port.desc: Built on the coast. Sends merchant ships to foreign ports and acts as a station. Radius of action of 60 tiles (+10 per level): warships are built and repaired inside it.

factory.name: Factory
factory.desc: Lays railways to stations within 110 tiles and runs trains.

defensePost.name: Defence post
defensePost.desc: Within 30 tiles: attacker losses ×5, speed ×3. Destroyed when captured.

silo.name: Missile silo
silo.desc: Launches A-bombs, H-bombs and MIRVs. Each upgrade adds a tube.

sam.name: SAM battery
sam.desc: Intercepts bombs and warheads with trajectory prediction. Range 70 → 140 tiles by level.

radar.name: Radar tower
radar.desc: Reveals the fog of war within 60 tiles.

airfield.name: Airfield
airfield.desc: Produces fighters, bombers and reconnaissance planes.

warship.name: Warship
warship.desc: Placed on water, within the radius of action of one of your ports. Firing range 130 tiles; targets transports first, then warships, and captures merchants. Gains veterancy and patrols around its anchor point.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.desc: Intercepts bombers and transports within 90 tiles of its airfield.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.desc: Kills troops in a 6-tile radius, no fallout. Can be intercepted.

nukeMirv.name: MIRV
nukeMirv.desc: 25M + 15M per previous launch. Splits into 8–12 warheads.

worldEvent.crisis: Global economic crisis: −25% income for 2 minutes.
worldEvent.boom: Trade boom: trade and trains pay double!
worldEvent.solarStorm: Solar storm: radars are blind for 90 s.
worldEvent.peaceSummit: Peace summit: forced truce for 60 seconds.

lan.title: Local network multiplayer
lan.hostDesc: Opens a lobby on this computer. Other players on the network see it automatically or can type your IP and the code.
lan.desktopOnly: Network play requires the desktop app.
lan.connectionLost: Connection to the host lost — reconnecting…
lan.subtitle: Play together on the same local network, with no external server.
lan.hostStep1: Click Host: a lobby opens with a code and an address.
lan.hostStep2: Other players see your game in the list, or type the address and the code.

campaign.title: Campaign: The Cartographers
campaign.intro: Six missions to learn how to draw, hold and defend your lines. Each mission awards up to three stars: success, speed and bonus objective.
campaign.failed: We lost our lands. Let's try again.

m1.title: First Lines
m1.summary: Between two lakes, take 15% of the land.
m1.d1: Welcome, cartographer. Every line you draw on this map becomes a border.
m1.d2: Spread over free land, then absorb the neighbouring tribes. Aim for 15% of the territory.
m1.outro: Fine first lines. The nations have noticed your ink.
m1.brief: Two great lakes divide this region. Three small nations are settling here, surrounded by tribes that guard their gold. You start from nothing: a point on the map and a few thousand men. Your mission is to become a regional power by controlling fifteen percent of the land.
m1.tip1: A click on unclaimed land sends the share of troops set at the bottom left. Several small clicks beat a single large one.
m1.tip2: Cities greatly increase your population: build them as soon as gold allows.

m2.title: Hold the Line
m2.summary: Survive 20 minutes in Europe against aggressive nations.
m2.d1: Europe is a powder keg. The neighbouring nations are warlike.
m2.d2: Hold for 10 minutes. Defence posts multiply attacker losses by five.
m2.outro: Your lines held. The attackers broke against your ramparts.
m2.brief: Europe is a powder keg. Thirty nations fight over every valley, and the difficulty is set to hard. You will not win this war; the task is not to lose it. Hold out for twenty minutes without being wiped off the map.
m2.tip1: Mountains, hills and forests cost the attacker more: lean on them.
m2.tip2: A defence post multiplies the attacker's losses by five within thirty tiles.

m3.title: The Island
m3.summary: In the archipelago, eliminate a nation from the sea.
m3.d1: Islands are won at sea. Click a coast across the water to land troops.
m3.d2: Eliminate at least one nation. Beware of warships that sink transports.
m3.brief: An archipelago of hundreds of islands. Here, every conquest goes through the sea. A dozen nations share the coasts, and their warships sink careless transports. Eliminate at least one rival nation.
m3.tip1: Click a coast across the water: your troops embark from your nearest shore.
m3.tip2: A port lets you build warships to escort your landings.

m4.title: Rails and Riches
m4.summary: On Pangaea, earn 3 million from trade and trains.
m4.d1: Wealth flows. Factories lay rails to your cities and ports.
m4.d2: Trains pay at every stop, merchant ships at every foreign port. Earn 3 million.
m4.outro: Your iron lines became lines of credit.
m4.brief: Pangaea joins all land into a single continent: trade routes here are long and lucrative. Your goal is not conquest but fortune. Earn three million gold through sea trade and trains.
m4.tip1: A factory automatically links your nearby cities, ports and factories by rail. Every train stop pays gold.
m4.tip2: Ports send merchant ships to foreign ports; an embargo cuts that trade.

m5.title: Artificial Sun
m5.summary: In the Mediterranean, launch an H-bomb.
m5.d1: Some lines are only drawn with fire. Build a silo and amass 5 million.
m5.d2: Launch an H-bomb. Enemy SAM batteries can intercept it: aim well.
m5.bonus: Intercept a missile with a SAM
m5.outro: The world saw your sun. It will not forget it.
m5.brief: The Mediterranean, cradle of empires. Some borders are only drawn in fire. You must acquire the ultimate weapon and use it: launch a hydrogen bomb. Beware, enemy SAM batteries can intercept it.
m5.tip1: A silo costs one million; the hydrogen bomb costs five. Grow your economy first.
m5.tip2: Aim far from any SAM battery: the missile can be intercepted in flight.

m6.title: One Minute to Midnight
m6.d1: The clock is ticking. After 10 minutes, those holding too little land collapse.
m6.d2: Reach 40% of the world before it is too late.
m6.outro: You stopped the clock. The atlas now bears your name.
m6.brief: The whole world, and a ticking clock. After ten minutes, any nation that holds too little land collapses, and the threshold keeps rising. Reach forty percent of the world before the clock catches up with you.
m6.tip1: Watch the threshold at the top of the screen: below it, your troops melt away.
m6.tip2: Tribes and unclaimed land are your first targets; keep the big wars for later.

campaign.briefingHint: The game is paused until you start the mission.
campaign.starsRule: One star for success, one for beating the par time, one for the bonus objective.
campaign.lockedHint: Complete the previous mission to unlock this one.

tutorial.spawn: Click on unclaimed land to place your capital. The match starts right away.
tutorial.camera: Move the map by dragging it, and zoom with the mouse wheel or by pinching the trackpad.
tutorial.expand: Click on the unclaimed land around you: your troops spread out. Reach 1,200 tiles.
tutorial.ratio: The attack ratio sets the share of troops sent with each order. Change it with T and Y, or with Shift and the wheel.
tutorial.city: Build a city: press 1 then click your territory, or right click, Build, City. Cities increase your population.
tutorial.attack: Attack the neighbouring tribe, in grey: one click on its border is enough. You will take a share of its gold.
tutorial.port: Build a port on the coast with key 2. It generates trade and lets you build warships.
tutorial.alliance: Open the Diplomacy panel on the left and propose an alliance to a neighbouring nation.
tutorial.tech: Open the Technologies panel on the left and choose a branch to research.
tutorial.done: You know the essentials. Carry on with this match, or start the campaign from the main menu.
tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.brief: Welcome. This tutorial teaches you the essentials in about six minutes: choosing a starting point, expanding, building, attacking and forming alliances. Each step stays on screen until you have completed it.
tutorial.tip1: Left click to attack or expand, right click for the actions menu.
tutorial.tip2: Hover over any part of the interface for an explanation.

guide.spawn: Choose where to place your capital: click on unclaimed land, ideally away from other nations. The match starts as soon as you have placed it.

m1.expand: Expand: click on unclaimed land along your border. Your troops advance on their own while they have the strength.
m1.city: Your population soon reaches its ceiling. Build a city: press 1 then click your territory, or right click, Build, City.
m1.tribes: Tribes, in grey, guard a treasury. Attack one: each piece of land you take yields a share of its gold.
m1.goal: Keep going until you hold fifteen percent of the land. A second city earns the bonus star.

m2.spawn: Place your capital. Rugged terrain, such as the Alps or the Carpathians, will be easier to defend.
m2.expand: Take unclaimed land quickly, before neighbouring nations surround you.
m2.defense: Build a defence post (key 4) near your most exposed border.
m2.troops: Keep at least half of your population under arms: set the Troop share slider to 50% or more.
m2.alliance: Propose an alliance to a neighbour from the Diplomacy panel. An ally cannot attack you.
m2.hold: Hold out until the countdown ends. Reinforce the fronts that give way and renew your alliances.

m3.island: Start by taking your whole island.
m3.port: Build a port (key 2) on your coast.
m3.landing: The weakest nation is marked on the map. Click its coast to launch a landing.
m3.finish: Keep going until it is eliminated. Send reinforcements by sea if the attack runs out of steam.

m4.expand: Expand to make room: railways need distance between stations.
m4.cities: Build two cities: they will be your first stations.
m4.factory: Build a factory (key 3) between your cities. The tracks are laid automatically.
m4.port: Build a port to add sea trade to your income.
m4.wait: Your network is running. Add factories and stations to multiply stops, and avoid wars that cut the lines.

m5.expand: Expand to build up your economy.
m5.city: Build two cities to raise population and income.
m5.launch: Press 9 then click an enemy target. A possible target is marked on the map.

m6.expand: Expand as fast as you can.
m6.economy: Build three cities to sustain the war effort.
m6.clock: The doomsday clock starts at ten minutes. Get ready to exceed the required share.
m6.push: Push towards forty percent. A vulnerable nation is marked on the map.

hover.attackCostTip: Attacker loss multiplier on this terrain (plains = ×1.00).

modeDesc.ffa: Free for all: the first to reach the land threshold wins.
modeDesc.teams: Players and nations are split into teams; a team's land adds up.
modeDesc.humansVsNations: All human players team up against all nations.
modeDesc.tribes: No nations, only tribes. Ideal for practice.
modeDesc.doomsday: After 10 minutes a minimum share of land is required, and it keeps rising.
modeDesc.battleRoyale: Every 3 minutes a zone shrinks; land outside it becomes uninhabitable.

difficultyDesc.impossible: Very rich, fast and ruthless nations.

ruleDesc.allowPorts: Allows ports, warships and sea trade.
ruleDesc.allowNukes: Allows silos, A-bombs, H-bombs and MIRVs.
ruleDesc.allowDonations: Allows gifts of gold and troops between allies.
ruleDesc.waterNukes: Nuclear blasts over water also leave fallout.
ruleDesc.decontamination: Fallout disappears after 10 minutes instead of staying.
ruleDesc.allowSpectators: Allows spectators to join the game.
